english.title: Speeding - exceed 70 mph motorway limit - manned equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding 70 miles per hour
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 3 of the Motorways Traffic (Speed Limit) Regulations 1974, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drive a motor vehicle
on a motorway
at a speed exceed 70 mph

english.notes:
(i) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wording: H877 - relating to unmanned automatic equipment.
(iii) See also temporary speed limit on motorway (road works) - H4690
